hypotheses.title: Sector-Neutralized Ultra Long-Term LEAPS VRP (1080d / 120d)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: De-correlates the 1.51-Sharpe / 1.06-Fitness LEAPS VRP alpha from prior subindustry alphas by neutralizing across GICS Sectors. Captures broad macro sector-level volatility risk premiums with low turnover (~12%) and breaks cross-candidate correlation below 0.70.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if sector neutralization elevates turnover above 25% or degrades Sharpe below 1.25.

candidates.rationale: Sector-neutralized 1080d LEAPS call IV over 120d historical volatility with 120d backfill

hypotheses.title: Model Domain GARP: Analyst Estimate Revision vs Relative Valuation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the Growth at a Reasonable Price (GARP) anomaly using registered BRAIN fundamental score derivatives. Long stocks with strong positive analyst revision momentum while penalizing overvalued stocks. Completely orthogonal to options and price-volume domains (Self-Correlation < 0.25).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if expensive stocks outperform revision momentum during speculative bull markets.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-ranked analyst revisions minus relative valuation rank derivative
